jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people.

Your role

The Taiwan Intermediary sales team is currently made up of professionals who prospect and service intermediary clients throughout Taiwan by marketing Pictet Asset Management’s (Pictet AM) strategies.

Reporting to the Head of Sales - Taiwan, you will play a critical role in Pictet AM’s drive to further develop its business in Taiwan. Your responsibilities will be:

• Foster strong collaborative relationships with distributors and financial advisors to boost sales activities.

• Address and assist distributors' headquarters and clients in resolving product and market-related inquiries while nurturing relationships.

• Organize seminars and meetings to facilitate engagement and knowledge sharing.

• Actively participate in fund sales initiatives and strive to partner with distributors in campaigns to achieve the company's business goals and increase brand awareness.

• Regularly visit branches for fund promotion and training.

• Gather, organize, analyse, and share market intelligence related to distributors and industry peers.

• Contribute to the development of effective sales strategies based on market insights.

• Proactively carry out tasks assigned by the sales head, ensuring efficient and accurate completion of various assignments.

• Maintain various documents, including updating client contact information, preparing call reports, and documenting activity notes in Salesforce (SF).

Your profile

• Hold a university degree or higher, with a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in the financial industry.

• Have a deep understanding of various mutual fund products, such as equity, fixed-income, private equity and ETFs.

• Possess excellent interpersonal skills that foster effective teamwork and communication.

• Exhibit strong presentation skills to deliver persuasive sales pitches.

• Demonstrate problem-solving abilities and a strong sense of responsibility and commitment to the business.

As the successful applicant you will show drive, have a keen entrepreneurial spirit and be able to develop successful business relationships and close deals. You will also have a flair for communication, be able to manage priorities and multi-task on different projects concurrently, as well as having an eye for detail. Working in a self-reliant manner in a broader team makes you excel. You will be joining a structured and highly motivated team.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Your team

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 600 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units, and include the Communications, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Strategy & Projects, Risk and Tax departments.

In this role, you will lead and coordinate multiple sensitive and complex cross-functional Risk & Compliance projects at the Group level, steering them from strategic, operational, and organizational standpoints.

You will work in close partnership with Business Lines, Group entities, and the Group Chief Risk Officer to ensure the effective execution and successful delivery of critical initiatives.

Your responsibilities will include driving project governance, fostering collaboration across teams, and ensuring alignment with the Group’s overall objectives.

Your role

• Lead change management projects and programs, including defining roles and responsibilities, establishing project governance, ensuring the quality of deliverables, managing budgets, assessing risks, and designing new processes.
• Coordinate communication with stakeholders, organize training sessions, and ensure a thorough understanding of business needs and requirements.
• Propose and develop innovative solutions, make actionable recommendations, implement changes, and monitor project timelines and milestones.
• Prepare and present regular project updates to senior management and stakeholders.
• Contribute to the development of new solutions and define next steps for ongoing initiatives.
• Proactively challenge existing business practices, suggest improvements or new programs, and take full ownership of deliverables.
• Identify, evaluate, and implement new services and tools to enhance operational efficiency.

Your profile

• Master’s degree or equivalent qualification.
• Minimum of 10 years’ experience in project management, ideally within consulting and/or strategy firms. Experience in the financial or banking industry is a strong asset.
• Interest in data analytics and business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, BO), ability to work with AI, machine learning, and automation technologies.
• Proven learning agility and adaptability to thrive in a rapidly evolving technological and financial landscape.
• Highly self-motivated and autonomous, with strong conceptual thinking, an entrepreneurial mindset, and exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities.
• Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with a track record of effective collaboration in diverse, cross-functional environments.
• Full professional proficiency in both French and English, written and spoken.
• Must be resident in Switzerland.

As the successful candidate, you should be solutions oriented with excellent communication skills, thorough in your approach to your work and capable of showing initiative. You will also possess excellent analytical and strong technical skills together with proven diplomatic and interpersonal skills. Furthermore, you are able to work autonomously while showing a strong team-spirit.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies.

La tua squadra Le funzioni aziendali includono le attività non bancarie del Gruppo e impiega oltre 600 persone. Queste funzioni sono svolte da specialisti con competenze in tutte le unità aziendali, e includono le comunicazioni, conformità, finanza, risorse umane, sicurezza dell'informazione, controllo interno, legale, strategia e progetti, dipartimenti di rischio e fiscale. In questo ruolo, guiderai e coordinerai più progetti di Risk & Compliance interfunzionali e sensibili a livello del Gruppo, guidandoli da punti di vista strategici, operativi e organizzativi. Si lavorerà in stretta collaborazione con Business Lines, entità di Gruppo e il responsabile del gruppo per garantire l'effettiva esecuzione e la consegna di iniziative critiche. Le tue responsabilità includono la guida della governance del progetto, la promozione della collaborazione tra le squadre e l’allineamento con gli obiettivi generali del Gruppo. Il tuo ruolo - Progetti e programmi di gestione dei cambiamenti di piombo, tra cui la definizione di ruoli e responsabilità, la definizione della governance del progetto, la garanzia della qualità dei responsabili, la gestione dei bilanci, la valutazione dei rischi e la progettazione di nuovi processi. - Coordinare la comunicazione con gli stakeholder, organizzare sessioni di formazione e garantire una comprensione approfondita delle esigenze e dei requisiti aziendali. - Proporre e sviluppare soluzioni innovative, formulare raccomandazioni attuabili, implementare modifiche e monitorare tempi e pietre miliari del progetto. - Preparare e presentare aggiornamenti regolari del progetto alla gestione senior e agli stakeholder. - Contribuire allo sviluppo di nuove soluzioni e definire i prossimi passi per iniziative in corso. - Proattivamente sfidare le pratiche commerciali esistenti, suggerire miglioramenti o nuovi programmi, e prendere la piena proprietà dei responsabili. - Identificare, valutare e implementare nuovi servizi e strumenti per migliorare l'efficienza operativa. Il tuo profilo - Laurea magistrale o equivalente. - Esperienza minima di 10 anni nella gestione del progetto, idealmente all’interno di imprese di consulenza e/o strategia. L'esperienza nel settore finanziario o bancario è un bene forte. - Interesse per l'analisi dei dati e strumenti di business intelligence (ad esempio Tableau, BO), capacità di lavorare con AI, machine learning e tecnologie di automazione. - Prove agilità di apprendimento e adattabilità per prosperare in un panorama tecnologico e finanziario in rapida evoluzione. - Altamente automotivato e autonomo, con forte pensiero concettuale, una mentalità imprenditoriale, e eccezionali capacità analitiche e problem solving. - Eccellente capacità di gestione interpersonale e degli stakeholder, con un track record di collaborazione efficace in ambienti diversi e interfunzionali. - Completa competenza professionale sia in francese che in inglese, scritta e parlata. - Dev'essere residente in Svizzera. Come candidato di successo, si dovrebbe essere soluzioni orientate con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione, approfondito nel vostro approccio al vostro lavoro e in grado di mostrare l'iniziativa. Potrai anche possedere eccellenti competenze tecniche analitiche e forti insieme a comprovate capacità diplomatiche e interpersonali. Inoltre, sei in grado di lavorare autonomamente mostrando un forte spirito di squadra. Nota Non accetteremo alcun CV tramite agenzie. SPM/MH/PM Diversità e inclusione Pictet è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e si impegna a creare un ambiente diverso. Tableau, BO), der Fähigkeit, mit KI zu arbeiten, maschinellem Lernen und Automatisierungstechnologien. Votre équipe Les fonctions d'entreprise comprennent les activités non bancaires du Groupe et emploient plus de 600 personnes. Ces fonctions sont exercées par des spécialistes spécialisés dans toutes les unités opérationnelles et comprennent les services des communications, de la conformité, des finances, des ressources humaines, de la sécurité de l'information, de la vérification interne, des services juridiques, de la stratégie et des projets, du risque et de l'impôt. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez et coordonnerez de multiples projets interfonctionnels sensibles et complexes de gestion des risques et de conformité au niveau du Groupe, en les dirigeant d'un point de vue stratégique, opérationnel et organisationnel. Vous travaillerez en partenariat étroit avec les secteurs d'activité, les entités du Groupe et le chef de la direction des risques du Groupe pour assurer l'exécution efficace et la mise en oeuvre réussie des initiatives essentielles. Vos responsabilités comprendront la conduite des projets, la promotion de la collaboration entre les équipes et l'harmonisation avec les objectifs généraux du Groupe. Votre rôle - Diriger les projets et les programmes de gestion du changement, y compris la définition des rôles et des responsabilités, l'établissement de la gouvernance des projets, l'assurance de la qualité des produits livrables, la gestion des budgets, l'évaluation des risques et la conception de nouveaux processus. - Coordonner la communication avec les intervenants, organiser des séances de formation et assurer une compréhension approfondie des besoins et des exigences des entreprises. - Proposer et développer des solutions novatrices, formuler des recommandations concrètes, mettre en oeuvre des changements et surveiller les calendriers et les étapes du projet. - Préparer et présenter régulièrement des mises à jour de projet à la haute direction et aux intervenants. - Contribuer à l'élaboration de nouvelles solutions et définir les prochaines étapes des initiatives en cours. - Définer proactivement les pratiques opérationnelles existantes, suggérer des améliorations ou de nouveaux programmes, et s'approprier pleinement les produits livrables. - Identifier, évaluer et mettre en oeuvre de nouveaux services et outils pour améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle. En tant que candidat retenu, vous devriez être orienté vers des solutions avec d'excellentes compétences en communication, une approche approfondie de votre travail et capable de faire preuve d'initiative. Vous posséderez également d'excellentes compétences analytiques et techniques solides ainsi que des compétences diplomatiques et interpersonnelles éprouvées. jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.
By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

As part of the Client Register team , you will contribute to the management and integrity of client data, supporting the bank’s core operations and ensuring a high standard of service for internal stakeholders and client-facing teams, without direct contact with clients.

Your main responsibilities will include managing the opening and closing of customer accounts for the bank and its branches, as well as handling credit card administration for customers. This involves updating static data and the services selected by our clients and performing “Cotation” tasks such as signature verification.

In addition, you will play a central role in the transformation of our activities by driving the identification, implementation, and optimization of automation and digitalization solutions for our processes. You will ensure strict adherence to internal procedures and regulatory requirements, while supporting the various business lines of the Bank.

Your role

• Play a key role in managing client account openings and updates for individuals, legal entities, and trusts, ensuring a seamless client experience.

• Strive for excellence in data quality and completeness, supporting both business growth and regulatory requirements.

• Take charge of credit card administration, working closely with service providers to deliver efficient solutions.

• Perform analysis of account structures and verification of client signatures to ensure the validity and compliance of payment instructions.

• Make a real impact by contributing to data remediation initiatives and maintaining accurate client records.

• Be proactive in improving departmental procedures, keeping us aligned with the latest industry standards.

• Embrace digital transformation by supporting the adoption of automation and AI solutions.

• Foster consistency and efficiency by promoting process harmonization across the Group.

• Get involved in projects that drive innovation and enhance client data management.

• Collaborate with dedicated colleagues and key stakeholders across the business.

• Be a valued partner, responding to requests from all business lines regarding Client Register activities.

Your profile

Requested experience:

• Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree, ideally complemented by initial experience in the banking sector (Operations)

Soft skills:

• Meticulous, detail-oriented, and organized, delivering work of the highest quality.

• Dynamic, proactive in problem-solving, and demonstrates an entrepreneurial spirit.

• Able to meet deadlines, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple assignments simultaneously.

• Discreet and able to handle sensitive and confidential information with the utmost professionalism.

Technical skills:

• Proficient in standard MS Office products.

• Interest in automation, digitalization, and new technologies, with the ability to design, maintain, or improve automated operational tools (Python, SQL, low-code, LLMs, AI agents, etc.), while adhering to security and compliance standards is a strong asset.

Language skills:

• Fluent in written and spoken French. Good command of English. German is an asset.

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 600 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units, and include Communications, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Organisation & Digital, Risk and Tax departments.

The Corporate Compliance Officer participates in monitoring the company's activities to ensure compliance with applicable regulations and also takes part in the implementation of the CMP (Control Monitoring Plan). He also ensures the strengthening of the company's procedural and training framework.

Your role

• Analyze regulatory watch screenings performing gap analysis on new regulations and assess their potential impact within the company.

• Contribute to the development and implementation of the Compliance Monitoring Plan by identifying applicable compliance standards and monitoring controls using a risk-based approach.

• Identify and assess compliance risks to which the company is exposed, make appropriate observations, and verify appropriate follow up on related to identified issues with the different stakeholders.

• Assist in establishing and maintaining a compliance manual, ensuring that all internal policies and procedures comply with legal requirements and group minimum standards.

• Assist in the training of new employees on compliance topics and ensure that compliance training is conducted at defined intervals.

• Participate in regulatory projects by providing advice on legal requirements and ensuring that delivered solutions comply with regulations and minimum group standards.

• Maintain and update various registers, including investor complaints, conflicts of interest, personal transactions, gifts, and identified issues.

• Follow up on audit recommendations and participate in the proper implementation.

• Collaborate with regulators and the Ministry of Finance to ensure compliance and respond to regulatory requests.

Request experience:

• Bachelor or Master degree in compliance, legal or related field.

• 3 to 5 years of experience is a equivalent role.

• Discretion, rigor, and reliability.

• Analytical skills and critical thinking.

• Good organizational and priority management skills.

• Ability to navigate complex and constantly evolving environments

• Good knowledge of European and Luxembourgish regulations.

• Understanding of the operational mechanisms of a management company and the associated regulatory framework.

jobs.title: Economist
jobs.description:
Your team

We are an independent investment partnership known for our long-term mindset, responsible approach to business, and entrepreneurial spirit. These principles have defined us since 1805. For our clients, colleagues and wider society, we always aim to do the right thing and honour our commitment to enduring quality.

Pictet opened its Tokyo office in 1981 to conduct research on the Japanese economy and equity market. It began providing asset management services to institutional investors in 1987 and entered the investment trust (mutual fund) business in 1997. As of the end of March 2026, the firm’s assets under management totaled 4.56 trillion yen.

Your role

We are seeking an economist to lead our global research and analysis on macroeconomics, monetary policy, interest rates, and foreign exchange.

Key responsibilities include preparing reports and presentation materials on macroeconomic and financial market developments; delivering presentations to retail and institutional investors, financial institutions, and the media; and providing clear explanations and interpretive support during client meetings.

The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills and excellent communication abilities, with the proven ability to convey complex information effectively in both English and Japanese.

Responsibilities

• Conduct in-depth analysis of macroeconomic trends, monetary policy, interest rates, and foreign exchange in Japan and globally

• Prepare reports and presentation materials for both internal and external stakeholders

• Deliver presentations to retail and institutional investors, financial institutions, and the media

• Provide clear explanations and interpretation support during client meetings

Your profile

• Bachelor’s degree or higher

• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience as an economist

• Deep understanding of macroeconomics and financial markets

• Native-level proficiency in Japanese and business-level or higher proficiency in English (reading, writing, and speaking)

• Excellent report writing and presentation skills

• Demonstrated experience in client-facing roles

Required Qualifications and Skills

• Certified Member Analyst of the Securities Analysts Association of Japan (CMA) or Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)

• Bloomberg

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.
